 public int SalvageEarned { get; private set; }\n        public int TowersBuilt { get; private set; }\n        public 
float Elapsed { get; private set; }\n\n        // Active wave spawn schedule.\n        private List<(float time, 
string enemyId, int gate)> _spawnSchedule;\n        private int _spawnCursor;\n        private float _waveClock;\n     
   private float _waveScheduledLength;\n        private int _nextEnemyId = 1;\n\n        private readonly string 
_levelId;\n        private readonly ulong _runSeed;\n\n        public GameSim(ContentDb db, TileGrid grid, TideSystem 
tide, IList<WaveDef> waves,\n            DifficultyDef difficulty, string levelId, ulong runSeed, bool endless)\n      
  {\n            Db = db;\n            Grid = grid;\n            Tide = tide;\n            Difficulty = difficulty;\n  
          _levelId = levelId;\n            _runSeed = runSeed == 0 ? 1UL : runSeed;\n            Endless = endless;\n  
          _waves = new List<WaveDef>(waves);\n            Paths = new PathService(grid);\n            Economy = new 
Economy(difficulty.StartingSalvage);\n            LanternLightMax = difficulty.LanternLight;\n            LanternLight 
= LanternLightMax;\n            Rng = new SeededRng(_runSeed);\n            NextWaveIndex = 0;\n            
grid.ApplyTidePhase(tide.CurrentPhase);\n            Paths.RecomputeAll();\n            Tide.OnPhaseTurn += 
HandleTideTurn;\n        }\n\n        // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n        
// Building / selling / upgrading\n        // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n   
     public bool TryBuildTower(string towerId, GridPos plot, out string failReason)\n        {\n            failReason 
= null;\n            if (GameOver) { failReason = \"Game is over.\"; return false; }\n            if 
(!Db.TryGetTower(towerId, out var def)) { failReason = \"Unknown tower.\"; return false; }\n            var tile = 
Grid.Get(plot);\n            if (tile == null || tile.Terrain != TerrainType.BuildPlot)\n            { failReason = 
\"Must build on a raised plot.\"; return false; }\n            if (tile.OccupiedByTowerId != null)\n            { 
failReason = \"Plot already occupied.\"; return false; }\n            int cost = def.Tiers[0].Cost;\n            if 
(!Economy.CanAfford(cost))\n            { failReason = \"Not enough Salvage.\"; return false; }\n\n            
Economy.TrySpend(cost);\n            bool adjacentPrism = HasAdjacentPrism(plot);\n            var inst = new 
TowerInstance(def, plot, adjacentPrism);\n            Grid.TryPlaceTower(plot, towerId);\n            
Towers.Add(inst);\n            TowersBuilt++;\n            Events.OnSalvageChanged?.Invoke(Economy.Salvage);\n         
   return true;\n        }\n\n        private bool HasAdjacentPrism(GridPos plot)\n        {\n            foreach (var 
n in Grid.Neighbours(plot))\n            {\n                var t = Grid.Get(n);\n                if (t != null && 
t.OccupiedByTowerId == TowerIds.PrismArray) return true;\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n      
  public bool TrySellTower(TowerInstance inst, out int refund)\n        {\n            refund = 0;\n            if 
(inst == null || !Towers.Contains(inst)) return false;\n            refund = Economy.SellRefund(inst.TotalInvested);\n 
           Economy.AddSalvage(refund);\n            Grid.TryRemoveTower(inst.Plot);\n            
Towers.Remove(inst);\n            Events.OnSalvageChanged?.Invoke(Economy.Salvage);\n            return true;\n        
}\n\n        public bool TryUpgradeTower(TowerInstance inst)\n        {\n            if (inst == null || GameOver) 
return false;\n            bool ok = inst.TryUpgrade(Economy);\n            if (ok) 
Events.OnSalvageChanged?.Invoke(Economy.Salvage);\n            return ok;\n        }\n\n        public bool 
TryPickBranch(TowerInstance inst, bool branchA)\n        {\n            if (inst == null || GameOver) return false;\n  
          bool ok = inst.TryPickBranch(branchA, Economy);\n            if (ok) 
Events.OnSalvageChanged?.Invoke(Economy.Salvage);\n            return ok;\n        }\n\n        // 
------------------------------------------------------------------\n        // Wave control\n        // 
------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n        /// <summary>Call the next wave. If 
called while a wave is active, pays early-call bonus.</summary>\n        public bool TryCallWave()\n        {\n        
    if (GameOver) return false;\n            if (WaveActive) return false; // one wave at a time\n            if 
(NextWaveIndex >= WaveCount && !Endless) return false;\n\n            WaveDef wave;\n            if (NextWaveIndex < 
WaveCount)\n            {\n                wave = _waves[NextWaveIndex];\n            }\n            else\n            
{\n                // Endless: generate a scaled wave deterministically.\n                wave = 
GenerateEndlessWave(NextWaveIndex);\n            }\n            StartWave(wave);\n            NextWaveIndex++;\n       
     return true;\n        }\n\n        /// <summary>Call the wave early; grants a bonus for the time 
skipped.</summary>\n        public int CallWaveEarlyBonus()\n        {\n            // Bonus is for time remaining on 
the current wave's schedule.\n            float remaining = WaveActive ? _waveScheduledLength - _waveClock : 0f;\n     
       return Economy.EarlyCallBonus(remaining);\n        }\n\n        private void StartWave(WaveDef wave)\n        
{\n            WaveActive = true;\n            _waveClock = 0f;\n            _spawnCursor = 0;\n            
_spawnSchedule = WaveSystem.BuildSpawnSchedule(wave, Rng);\n            _waveScheduledLength = _spawnSchedule.Count > 
0 ? _spawnSchedule[_spawnSchedule.Count - 1].time : 0f;\n        }\n\n        private WaveDef GenerateEndlessWave(int 
index)\n        {\n            // Deterministic scaling from run seed + index.\n            int tier = index - 
WaveCount + 1;\n            var wave = new WaveDef { VarianceSeed = 0 };\n            int gates = Math.Max(1, 
Grid.Gates.Count);\n            string[] pool = {\n                EnemyIds.Skitterling, EnemyIds.BrineHulk, 
EnemyIds.AbyssalLurker,\n                EnemyIds.Spitter, EnemyIds.Broodmother\n            };\n            int 
entries = 2 + (tier % 3);\n            for (int i = 0; i < entries; i++)\n            {\n                string id = 
pool[Rng.Range(0, pool.Length)];\n                int count = 6 + tier * 2 + Rng.Range(0, 4);\n                
wave.Entries.Add(new SpawnEntry(id, count, 0.6f, Rng.Range(0, gates), i * 2f));\n            }\n            return 
wave;\n        }\n\n        // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n        // Main 
tick\n        // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n        public void Tick(float 
dt)\n        {\n            if (GameOver) return;\n            Elapsed += dt;\n\n            // Tide.\n            if 
(Tide.Tick(dt))\n            {\n                // phase turned; HandleTideTurn already applied via event\n            
}\n\n            // Spawning.\n            if (WaveActive)\n            {\n                _waveClock += dt;\n         
       while (_spawnCursor < _spawnSchedule.Count && _spawnSchedule[_spawnCursor].time <= _waveClock)\n                
{\n                    var s = _spawnSchedule[_spawnCursor];\n                    SpawnEnemy(s.enemyId, s.gate);\n     
               _spawnCursor++;\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Enemies.\n            for (int i = 
Enemies.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)\n            {\n                var e = Enemies[i];\n                if (e.Dead) { 
Enemies.RemoveAt(i); continue; }\n                TickEnemy(e, dt);\n                if (e.ReachedBase)\n              
  {\n                    Enemies.RemoveAt(i);\n                    Leak(e);\n                }\n            }\n\n      
      // Towers.\n            foreach (var t in Towers)\n            {\n                if (t.TickDisabled(dt)) 
Events.OnTowerReenabled?.Invoke(t);\n                if (!t.IsDisabled) TickTower(t, dt);\n            }\n\n           
 // Wave clear check.\n            if (WaveActive && _spawnCursor >= _spawnSchedule.Count && Enemies.Count == 0)\n     
       {\n                WaveActive = false;\n                OnWaveCleared();\n            }\n        }\n\n        
private void OnWaveCleared()\n        {\n            Economy.AddSalvage(Economy.WaveCompletionBonus);\n            
SalvageEarned += Economy.WaveCompletionBonus;\n            int dividend = Economy.PayReserveInterest();\n            
SalvageEarned += dividend;\n            Events.OnSalvageChanged?.Invoke(Economy.Salvage);\n            
Events.OnWaveCleared?.Invoke();\n\n            if (!Endless && NextWaveIndex >= WaveCount)\n            {\n            
    // Final wave cleared. If the lantern is still lit, victory.\n                if (LanternLight > 0)\n              
  {\n                    Won = true;\n                    GameOver = true;\n                    
Events.OnVictory?.Invoke();\n                }\n                // If LanternLight == 0 here, defeat already fired (0 
takes precedence).\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 
------------------------------------------------------------------\n        // Tide\n        // 
------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n        private void HandleTideTurn(TidePhase 
phase)\n        {\n            Grid.ApplyTidePhase(phase);\n            Paths.RecomputeAll();\n            // Living 
enemies re-path within this same tick; pelagic enemies caught on a\n            // drying tile become Beached; beached 
enemies on reflooded tiles recover.\n            foreach (var e in Enemies) Repath(e);\n            
Events.OnTideTurn?.Invoke(phase);\n        }\n\n        /// <summary>Recompute an enemy's remaining path from its 
current tile.</summary>\n        private void Repath(Enemy e)\n        {\n            GridPos cur = new 
GridPos((int)Math.Floor(e.X), (int)Math.Floor(e.Y));\n            var field = Paths.For(e.Def.MoveClass);\n\n          
  var tile = Grid.Get(cur);\n            // Pelagic beaching: on a dry tile with no water.\n            if 
(e.Def.MoveClass == MoveClass.Pelagic && tile != null && !tile.IsWater &&\n                tile.Terrain != 
TerrainType.Gate && tile.Terrain != TerrainType.Base)\n            {\n                e.Beached = true;\n            
}\n            else if (e.Beached && tile != null && tile.IsWater)\n            {\n                e.Beached = 
false;\n            }\n\n            if (!field.IsReachable(cur))\n            {\n                // Surrounded / no 
valid path: keep current path if still usable, else the\n                // enemy slows (Beached-equivalent) but never 
teleports or soft-locks.\n                if (e.Def.MoveClass == MoveClass.Terrestrial) e.SlowTimer = 
Math.Max(e.SlowTimer, 0.5f);\n                return;\n            }\n            var path = field.BuildPath(cur);\n   
         if (path.Count > 0)\n            {\n                e.Path = path;\n                e.PathIndex = 0;\n        
    }\n        }\n\n        // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n        // 
Enemies\n        // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n        private void 
SpawnEnemy(string enemyId, int gateIndex)\n        {\n            if (!Db.TryGetEnemy(enemyId, out var def)) return;\n 
           if (Grid.Gates.Count == 0) return;\n            var gate = Grid.Gates[Math.Clamp(gateIndex, 0, 
Grid.Gates.Count - 1)];\n            var e = new Enemy\n            {\n                Id = _nextEnemyId++,\n          
      Def = def,\n                MaxHp = def.BaseHp * Difficulty.EnemyHpMult,\n                Hp = def.BaseHp * 
Difficulty.EnemyHpMult,\n                X = gate.X + 0.5f,\n                Y = gate.Y + 0.5f,\n                
SpitTimer = def.SpitInterval,\n                TidecallTimer = def.TidecallInterval,\n                ShroudedActive = 
def.Shrouded,\n            };\n            Repath(e);\n            Enemies.Add(e);\n            
Events.OnEnemySpawned?.Invoke(e);\n        }\n\n        private void TickEnemy(Enemy e, float dt)\n        {\n         
   // Slow decay.\n            float speed = e.Def.BaseSpeed * Difficulty.EnemySpeedMult * e.SpeedMult;\n            
if (e.SlowTimer > 0f)\n            {\n                e.SlowTimer -= dt;\n                speed *= (1f - e.SlowPct);\n 
           }\n            if (e.Beached) speed *= 0.4f;\n\n            // Boss Tidecall.\n            if (e.Def.IsBoss 
&& e.Def.TidecallInterval > 0f)\n            {\n                e.TidecallTimer -= dt;\n                if 
(e.TidecallTimer <= 0f)\n                {\n                    e.TidecallTimer = e.Def.TidecallInterval;\n            
        Tide.ForceSurge();\n                    Events.OnTidecall?.Invoke();\n                }\n            }\n\n     
       // Spitter attack.\n            if (e.Def.SpitInterval > 0f)\n            {\n                e.SpitTimer -= 
dt;\n                if (e.SpitTimer <= 0f)\n                {\n                    e.SpitTimer = 
e.Def.SpitInterval;\n                    SpitAtNearestTower(e);\n                }\n            }\n\n            // 
Move along path.\n            MoveAlongPath(e, speed * dt);\n\n            // Shroud state recomputed against 
illumination each tick.\n            UpdateShroud(e);\n        }\n\n        private void MoveAlongPath(Enemy e, float 
dist)\n        {\n            float remaining = dist;\n            int guard = 64;\n            while (remaining > 0f 
&& guard-- > 0)\n            {\n                if (e.PathIndex >= e.Path.Count)\n                {\n                  
  // Reached the end of the path (base).\n                    e.ReachedBase = true;\n                    return;\n     
           }\n                var node = e.Path[e.PathIndex];\n                float tx = node.X + 0.5f, ty = node.Y + 
0.5f;\n                float dx = tx - e.X, dy = ty - e.Y;\n                float d = (float)Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * 
dy);\n                if (d <= remaining)\n                {\n                    e.X = tx; e.Y = ty;\n                
    remaining -= d;\n                    e.PathIndex++;\n                    e.RouteProgress += d;\n                
}\n                else\n                {\n                    e.X += dx / d * remaining;\n                    e.Y += 
dy / d * remaining;\n                    e.RouteProgress += remaining;\n                    remaining = 0f;\n          
      }\n            }\n        }\n\n        private void UpdateShroud(Enemy e)\n        {\n            if 
(!e.Def.Shrouded) { e.ShroudedActive = false; return; }\n            e.ShroudedActive = !IsIlluminated(e.X, e.Y);\n    
    }\n\n        /// <summary>Is a point illuminated by any light tower or the Lantern aura?</summary>\n        public 
bool IsIlluminated(float x, float y)\n        {\n            // Lantern aura at base.\n            var bp = 
Grid.BasePos;\n            float bx = bp.X + 0.5f, by = bp.Y + 0.5f;\n            float dx = x - bx, dy = y - by;\n    
        const float lanternAura = 3.5f;\n            if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= lanternAura * lanternAura) return 
true;\n\n            foreach (var t in Towers)\n            {\n                if (t.IsDisabled) continue;\n           
     var def = Db.GetTower(t.DefId);\n                if (!def.EmitsLight) continue;\n                var s = 
t.ResolveStats();\n                if (s.IlluminationRadius <= 0f) continue;\n                float tx = t.Plot.X + 
0.5f, ty = t.Plot.Y + 0.5f;\n                float ddx = x - tx, ddy = y - ty;\n                if (ddx * ddx + ddy * 
ddy <= s.IlluminationRadius * s.IlluminationRadius)\n                    return true;\n            }\n            
return false;\n        }\n\n        private void SpitAtNearestTower(Enemy e)\n        {\n            TowerInstance 
best = null;\n            float bestD = float.MaxValue;\n            foreach (var t in Towers)\n            {\n        
        if (t.IsDisabled) continue;\n                float d = GridPos.SqrDistance(new GridPos((int)e.X, (int)e.Y), 
t.Plot);\n                if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = t; }\n            }\n            if (best != null && 
bestD <= 6f * 6f)\n            {\n                best.DisabledTimer = e.Def.SpitDisableDuration;\n                
best.CurrentTargetId = -1;\n                Events.OnTowerDisabled?.Invoke(best);\n            }\n        }\n\n        
private void Leak(Enemy e)\n        {\n            int dmg = Math.Max(1, (int)(e.Def.LeakDamage * 
Difficulty.LeakMult));\n            LanternLight -= dmg;\n            Leaks++;\n            
Events.OnEnemyLeaked?.Invoke(e);\n            Events.OnLanternDamaged?.Invoke(LanternLight);\n            // 
Documented rule: defeat at 0 takes precedence over a simultaneous final kill.\n            if (LanternLight <= 0)\n    
        {\n                LanternLight = 0;\n                GameOver = true;\n                Won = false;\n         
       Events.OnDefeat?.Invoke();\n            }\n        }\n\n        /// <summary>Apply damage to an enemy; handles 
armor, beached bonus, split-on-death.</summary>\n        public void DamageEnemy(Enemy e, float rawDamage, 
TowerInstance source, bool isFlare)\n        {\n            if (e.Dead || GameOver) return;\n            float armor = 
Math.Max(0f, e.Def.Armor - e.ArmorShred);\n            float dmg = Math.Max(1f, rawDamage - armor);\n            if 
(isFlare && e.Beached && source != null)\n            {\n                var def = Db.GetTower(source.DefId);\n        
        dmg *= def.BonusVsBeached;\n            }\n            e.Hp -= dmg;\n            if (e.Hp <= 0f) Kill(e, 
source);\n        }\n\n        private void Kill(Enemy e, TowerInstance source)\n        {\n            if (e.Dead) 
return;\n            e.Dead = true;\n            int bounty = Economy.KillBounty(e.Def, Difficulty.BountyMult);\n      
      Economy.AddSalvage(bounty);\n            SalvageEarned += bounty;\n            
Events.OnSalvageChanged?.Invoke(Economy.Salvage);\n            Events.OnEnemyDied?.Invoke(e);\n\n            // 
Broodmother splits into Skitterlings.\n            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.Def.SplitIntoId) && 
Db.TryGetEnemy(e.Def.SplitIntoId, out var child))\n            {\n                for (int i = 0; i < 
e.Def.SplitCount; i++)\n                {\n                    var c = new Enemy\n                    {\n              
          Id = _nextEnemyId++,\n                        Def = child,\n                        MaxHp = child.BaseHp * 
Difficulty.EnemyHpMult,\n                        Hp = child.BaseHp * Difficulty.EnemyHpMult,\n                        
X = e.X + Rng.Range(-0.3f, 0.3f),\n                        Y = e.Y + Rng.Range(-0.3f, 0.3f),\n                    };\n 
                   Repath(c);\n                    Enemies.Add(c);\n                    
Events.OnEnemySpawned?.Invoke(c);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 
------------------------------------------------------------------\n        // Towers / combat\n        // 
------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n        private void TickTower(TowerInstance t, 
float dt)\n        {\n            var def = Db.GetTower(t.DefId);\n            if (!def.DealsDamage) { TickFogBell(t, 
def, dt); return; }\n\n            // Acquire a target.\n            Enemy target = AcquireTarget(t, def);\n           
 if (target == null)\n            {\n                t.CurrentTargetId = -1;\n                t.RampTime = 0f;\n       
         return;\n            }\n\n            // Beacon ramp: damage ramps while holding the same target.\n           
 if (def.Id == TowerIds.BeaconSpire)\n            {\n                if (t.CurrentTargetId == target.Id) t.RampTime += 
dt;\n                else { t.CurrentTargetId = target.Id; t.RampTime = 0f; }\n            }\n\n            // Fire 
rate gate.\n            t.RampTime = def.Id == TowerIds.BeaconSpire ? t.RampTime : t.RampTime; // no-op clarity\n      
      _fireCooldown.TryGetValue(t, out float cd);\n            cd -= dt;\n            if (cd > 0f) { _fireCooldown[t] 
= cd; return; }\n            var stats = t.ResolveStats();\n            cd = stats.FireRate > 0f ? 1f / stats.FireRate 
: 0.5f;\n            _fireCooldown[t] = cd;\n\n            Fire(t, def, stats, target);\n        }\n\n        private 
readonly Dictionary<TowerInstance, float> _fireCooldown = new Dictionary<TowerInstance, float>();\n\n        private 
void Fire(TowerInstance t, TowerDef def, TowerTierStats stats, Enemy target)\n        {\n            
Events.OnTowerFired?.Invoke(t, target);\n            switch (def.Id)\n            {\n                case 
TowerIds.BeaconSpire:\n                {\n                    float rampMult = 1f + Math.Min(2f, t.RampTime * 0.5f); 
// up to 3x ramp\n                    float dmg = stats.Damage * rampMult;\n                    var branch = 
t.ActiveBranch();\n                    if (branch != null && branch.BurstWindow && t.RampTime > 3f) dmg *= 1.5f; // 
Solar Lance\n                    DamageEnemy(target, dmg, t, false);\n                    if (branch != null && 
branch.AppliesSlowOnHit) // Dusk Beam\n                    {\n                        target.SlowPct = 0.3f;\n         
               target.SlowTimer = Math.Max(target.SlowTimer, 0.8f);\n                    }\n                    
break;\n                }\n                case TowerIds.FlareMortar:\n                {\n                    // Area 
damage around target with travel time abstracted; illuminates impact.\n                    float r = 1.5f;\n           
         foreach (var other in EnemiesWithin(target.X, target.Y, r))\n                        DamageEnemy(other, 
stats.Damage, t, true);\n                    Events.OnAreaIlluminated?.Invoke(\n                        new 
GridPos((int)target.X, (int)target.Y), 1.5f);\n                    break;\n                }\n                case 
TowerIds.PrismArray:\n                {\n                    // Chain-light arcs to N nearest additional enemies.\n    
                var chain = new List<Enemy> { target };\n                    Enemy cur = target;\n                    
for (int arc = 0; arc < stats.ChainArcs; arc++)\n                    {\n                        Enemy next = 
NearestEnemy(cur.X, cur.Y, 3f, chain);\n                        if (next == null) break;\n                        
chain.Add(next);\n                        cur = next;\n                    }\n                    float dmg = 
stats.Damage;\n                    foreach (var c in chain)\n                    {\n                        
DamageEnemy(c, dmg, t, false);\n                        dmg *= 0.85f; // falloff per arc\n                    }\n      
              break;\n                }\n                case TowerIds.HarpoonBallista:\n                {\n           
         // Pierces in a line toward the target.\n                    var dir = (target.X - (t.Plot.X + 0.5f), 
target.Y - (t.Plot.Y + 0.5f));\n                    float len = (float)Math.Sqrt(dir.Item1 * dir.Item1 + dir.Item2 * 
dir.Item2);\n                    if (len < 1e-4f) { DamageEnemy(target, stats.Damage, t, false); break; }\n            
        float nx = dir.Item1 / len, ny = dir.Item2 / len;\n                    int hits = 0;\n                    
foreach (var e in EnemiesAlongLine(t.Plot.X + 0.5f, t.Plot.Y + 0.5f, nx, ny, stats.Range))\n                    {\n    
                    DamageEnemy(e, stats.Damage, t, false);\n                        if (++hits > stats.Pierce) 
break;\n                    }\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        
private void TickFogBell(TowerInstance t, TowerDef def, float dt)\n        {\n            _fireCooldown.TryGetValue(t, 
out float cd);\n            cd -= dt;\n            if (cd > 0f) { _fireCooldown[t] = cd; return; }\n            var 
stats = t.ResolveStats();\n            cd = stats.FireRate > 0f ? 1f / stats.FireRate : 1f;\n            
_fireCooldown[t] = cd;\n\n            // Pulse: slow + armor shred everything in radius. Reveal is passive via 
EmitsLight.\n            foreach (var e in EnemiesWithin(t.Plot.X + 0.5f, t.Plot.Y + 0.5f, stats.Range))\n            
{\n                e.SlowPct = Math.Max(e.SlowPct, stats.SlowPct);\n                e.SlowTimer = 
Math.Max(e.SlowTimer, 1.0f);\n                if (stats.ArmorShred > 0f) e.ArmorShred = Math.Max(e.ArmorShred, 
stats.ArmorShred);\n            }\n            Events.OnTowerFired?.Invoke(t, null);\n        }\n\n        /// 
<summary>Targeting with selectable priority; applies the Shroud rule.</summary>\n        private Enemy 
AcquireTarget(TowerInstance t, TowerDef def)\n        {\n            var stats = t.ResolveStats();\n            float 
rangeSqr = stats.Range * stats.Range;\n            float tx = t.Plot.X + 0.5f, ty = t.Plot.Y + 0.5f;\n\n            
Enemy best = null;\n            float bestScore = 0f;\n            foreach (var e in Enemies)\n            {\n         
       if (e.Dead || e.ReachedBase) continue;\n                float dx = e.X - tx, dy = e.Y - ty;\n                if 
(dx * dx + dy * dy > rangeSqr) continue;\n                // Shroud: direct-fire towers cannot target Shrouded 
enemies.\n                if (def.DirectFire && e.ShroudedActive) continue;\n\n                float score;\n          
      switch (t.Priority)\n                {\n                    case TargetPriority.Last: score = -e.RouteProgress; 
break;\n                    case TargetPriority.Strongest: score = e.Hp; break;\n                    case 
TargetPriority.Closest: score = -(dx * dx + dy * dy); break;\n                    case TargetPriority.First:\n         
           default: score = e.RouteProgress; break;\n                }\n                if (best == null || score > 
bestScore)\n                {\n                    best = e;\n                    bestScore = score;\n                
}\n            }\n            return best;\n        }\n\n        // Non-allocating-ish helpers that reuse buffers (hot 
path: no LINQ, pooled lists).\n        private readonly List<Enemy> _buffer = new List<Enemy>(256);\n\n        private 
List<Enemy> EnemiesWithin(float x, float y, float r)\n        {\n            _buffer.Clear();\n            float rs = 
r * r;\n            foreach (var e in Enemies)\n            {\n                if (e.Dead || e.ReachedBase) 
continue;\n                float dx = e.X - x, dy = e.Y - y;\n                if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= rs) 
_buffer.Add(e);\n            }\n            return _buffer;\n        }\n\n        private Enemy NearestEnemy(float x, 
float y, float r, List<Enemy> exclude)\n        {\n            float rs = r * r;\n            Enemy best = null;\n     
       float bestD = float.MaxValue;\n            foreach (var e in Enemies)\n            {\n                if 
(e.Dead || e.ReachedBase || exclude.Contains(e)) continue;\n                float dx = e.X - x, dy = e.Y - y;\n        
        float d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n                if (d <= rs && d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = e; }\n            
}\n            return best;\n        }\n\n        private List<Enemy> EnemiesAlongLine(float x, float y, float nx, 
float ny, float len)\n        {\n            _buffer.Clear();\n            foreach (var e in Enemies)\n            {\n 
               if (e.Dead || e.ReachedBase) continue;\n                float rx = e.X - x, ry = e.Y - y;\n             
   float along = rx * nx + ry * ny;\n                if (along < 0f || along > len) continue;\n                float 
perp = Math.Abs(rx * ny - ry * nx);\n                if (perp <= 0.6f) _buffer.Add(e);\n            }\n

�"?�"?��' [Rising] �"?�"?��' [High] �"?�"?��' [Ebbing] �"?�"?�"~\n```\n\n- `Low` / `Rising` / `High` / `Ebbing` are

`OnTideTurn` event drives the water-rise animation and a surge sting.\n- A **Tide-turn warning banner** appears 5

|\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| Terrestrial | �o" | �o- | �o- | If surrounded by water: slowed (never stuck) |\n|

distance field** is computed backwards from the Lantern over\nthe *current* walkability graph (O(W��H) per recompute). 
Enemies walk \"downhill\" to the\nbase. Because a field covers the whole map, multiple gates and multiple lanes are 
handled\nuniformly and every enemy gets a next step without a per-enemy A*. Fields are recomputed on\nevery tide turn 
(towers sit on build plots, which are never walkable, so building does not\nchange the graph). An enemy whose current 
tile becomes unreachable keeps its last path if\nstill valid, otherwise is slowed �?" it never teleports and never 
soft-locks.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Economy\n\n| Source | Formula |\n|---|---|\n| Kill bounty | `max(1, floor(enemy.bounty �-

or a different version is reported and the caller falls back to a fresh run �?"\nit never crashes. When the schema 
changes, bump `CurrentVersion` and (optionally) write a\nmigration; the policy intentionally prefers a clean fresh-run 
fallback over risky migrations\nfor a save system that only spans one level's run.\n\n---\n\n## 10. Content schemas

Major Feature Areas\n\n### 4.1 Inference service\n- Load **one** torchvision pretrained model at startup (default 
`mobilenet_v3_small`, weights `IMAGENET1K_V1`); the exact weights enum is pinned in config and reported by the API.\n- 
Preprocessing must use the weights' own transform pipeline (`weights.transforms()`), including EXIF-orientation 
normalization before transforms.\n- Return **top-5** labels as softmax probabilities, rounded to 4 decimals, each 
paired with its ImageNet class name and its **mapped refurb category** (see 4.2).\n- Model runs on CPU, synchronously; 
target < 1.5 s per image on a commodity laptop. Inference must be wrapped so a model-internal failure surfaces as HTTP 
503 (`model_unavailable` or `inference_error`), never an unhandled traceback.\n- The classifier must be **behind an 
interface** so tests can inject a deterministic fake (see ��9).\n\n### 4.2 Domain mapping & routing (the anti-generic 
layer)\n- Ship a **versioned YAML mapping table** (`category_map.yaml`) translating a curated subset of ImageNet 
labels into refurb categories, e.g. `laptop ��' portable_computing`, `monitor ��' display`, `cellular_telephone ��' 
mobile_device`, `microwave ��' small_appliance`, `mouse ��' peripheral`. Unmapped labels fall through to category 
`unmapped_general`.\n- Each category has a **default routing hint**: `bench_test`, `parts_harvest`, 
`certified_recycle`, or `manual_sort`.\n- The mapping file version is stamped on every stored Prediction.\n\n### 4.3 
Threshold profiles\n- Profiles defined in config (YAML or env), e.g.:\n  - `strict-intake`: top-1 �%� 0.45 **and** 
margin over runner-up �%� 0.15 ��' auto-route; else review queue.\n  - `bin-sweep`: top-1 �%� 0.25 ��' auto-route.\n- 
Clients select a profile per request; unknown profile names ��' 422 with the list of valid profiles.\n- Predictions 
failing a profile create a **ReviewTask** with a machine-readable reason.\n\n### 4.4 Upload validation\n- Accept 
`image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp` via **magic-byte sniffing** (not extension or declared content-type alone).\n- 
Enforce: max size (default 10 MB, configurable), min dimensions (e.g., �%� 64�-64), decodable by PIL without 
exception, EXIF-orientation handled.\n- Every rejection is a clean 4xx with a structured error code 
(`unsupported_media_type`, `file_too_large`, `corrupt_image`, `dimensions_too_small`, `empty_file`) �?" distinct from 
5xx model failures.\n\n### 4.5 Review queue & feedback capture\n- List open tasks, fetch one, resolve as `confirmed` 
(accept top-1) or `corrected` (supply the right category from the known category list).\n- Resolutions are stored on 
the ReviewTask and back-reference the Prediction, forming a future evaluation dataset.\n\n### 4.6 Batch triage\n- 
Multi-file endpoint (up to 25 images per call) for pallet-scale processing. Per-file results with per-file status; one 
bad file must not sink the batch (partial-failure semantics, each entry carries its own error object). Summary counts 
included (`succeeded`, `needs_review`, `rejected`).\n\n### 4.7 History, stats & ops\n- Paginated prediction history, 
filterable by intake_tag, status, profile, mapped category, date range.\n- Lightweight stats endpoint: total

PalletLens\n\n**Intake triage vision API for electronics-reuse and refurbishment co-ops.**\n\nVolunteers photograph 
donated hardware at the intake dock (laptops, monitors,\nphones, small appliances, mystery cables). PalletLens runs a 
pretrained\ntorchvision ImageNet classifier **locally on CPU**, returns the **top-5 classes\nwith confidence scores**,
